column3: Close to the Hebrew; “hear righteousness” is rendered “Hear a just cause.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have watched the paths” is rendered “I have kept away from the paths,” and “the violent” “the destroyer.”
Close to the Hebrew; the statement “my steps have held fast” is rendered as a request, “Uphold my steps.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲסָדֶיךָ (“your acts of steadfast love”) is rendered “Your marvelous lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the pupil of the daughter of the eye” is rendered “the apple of Your eye.”
Close to the Hebrew; “enemies with soul” is rendered “deadly enemies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “their fat” is rendered “their fat hearts.”
The Hebrew is difficult; NKJV renders “men of the world who have their portion in this life,” and “sons” as “children.”
